lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One bifurcation is visible at the dorsal terminus of the fourth line from the anterior position, where it merges with the third line at the spinal ridge.

posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally, creating a short semi-connected geometric marker.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking across the nasal bridge and two distinct white patches located on the upper forelimbs.
